hook.text: This AI never writes a single sentence. It just makes decisions, fast and cheap. Here's Jev.
hook.tts: This A.I. never writes a single sentence. It just makes decisions, fast, and cheap. Here is Jev.

headline: Answers, not
essays
stories.text: Jev, from TypeSafe AI, doesn't generate text. It returns a typed answer with a probability, like route to billing, ninety two percent sure, that your software can use directly.
stories.tts: Jev, from Type Safe A.I., doesn't generate text. It returns a typed answer with a probability, like: route to billing, ninety two percent sure, that your software can use directly.

headline: Milliseconds,
fractions of a cent
stories.text: It answers in seventy to five hundred milliseconds, and costs about four cents per million input tokens. TypeSafe says that's roughly one two-hundredth of a frontier model's cost.
stories.tts: It answers in seventy to five hundred milliseconds, and costs about four cents per million input tokens. Type Safe says that is roughly one two-hundredth of a frontier model's cost.

headline: Where it
pays off
stories.text: Think support tickets routed instantly, AI agents choosing the right tool, and guardrails checking other models in real time. Millions of small decisions, for almost nothing.
stories.tts: Think support tickets routed instantly, A.I. agents choosing the right tool, and guardrails checking other models in real time. Millions of small decisions, for almost nothing.

headline: Not a
chatbot
stories.text: It needs a fixed set of possible answers, it struggles with counting and dates, and access is still a waitlist. It's a fast decision layer, not a replacement for ChatGPT.
stories.tts: It needs a fixed set of possible answers, it struggles with counting and dates, and access is still a waitlist. It is a fast decision layer, not a replacement for ChatGPT.
